name: sticky-banner
blurb: Sticky top banner with scroll-triggered hide and close button.
description: Sticky positioned container that animates down from top on mount, hides on scroll (if hideOnScroll enabled) via useScroll and useMotionValueEvent, with toggle close button.
use_when: You need a persistent banner that auto-hides when user scrolls, but can be reopened.
avoid_when: For permanently visible headers; use a fixed header instead.
a11y: Close button is keyboard accessible. Motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
